title: Ana and Lucy
text:
Ana has a small dog. The dog is brown and white. Its name is Lucy. Ana walks Lucy every morning in the park.

Lucy likes to run and play with a ball. After the walk, Ana gives Lucy water. Then Lucy sleeps under the table. Ana loves her dog.

questions.text: What does Lucy like to play with?
Why does Ana walk Lucy every morning?
options: Because Ana wants a new dog

questions.text: How does Ana feel about Lucy?

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people walk and play
a clear liquid that people and animals drink
a round object that people throw, kick or bounce

paragraph_translations: Ana tiene un perro pequeño. El perro es marrón y blanco. Su nombre es Lucy. Ana pasea a Lucy todas las mañanas en el parque.
A Lucy le gusta correr y jugar con una pelota. Después del paseo, Ana le da agua a Lucy. Luego Lucy duerme debajo de la mesa. Ana quiere mucho a su perro.
